item.name: Flame-Tongue Longsword
item.description: A finely crafted steel longsword engraved with runes that glow red when drawn.
item.uses: Bonus action command word ignites blade, dealing +2d6 fire damage on hit.

item.name: Potion of Healing
item.description: A shimmering red liquid that smells faintly of cinnamon and honey.
item.uses: Action to drink or administer to regain 2d4+2 hit points.

item.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
item.description: A lightweight green cloak that shifts color to match your surrounding terrain.
item.uses: Grants advantage on Stealth checks to hide while the hood is drawn.

item.name: Bag of Holding
item.description: A cloth sack that opens into a non-dimensional space roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep.
item.uses: Holds up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet, while always weighing 15 pounds.

item.name: Boots of Elvenkind
item.description: Soft leather boots embroidered with subtle leaf patterns that seem to absorb sound.
item.uses: Your steps make no sound regardless of the surface, granting advantage on Stealth checks that rely on moving silently.

item.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
item.description: A smooth mahogany wand tipped with a small, glowing blue sapphire.
item.uses: Action to expend 1 or more charges to cast Magic Missile. Has 7 charges and regains 1d6+1 daily at dawn.

item.name: Ring of Protection
item.description: A simple gold band etched with delicate protective runes along the inner rim.
item.uses: Grants a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn.

item.name: Immovable Rod
item.description: A flat iron rod with a small brass button on one end.
item.uses: Action to press the button, fixing the rod in place in mid-air until pressed again. Supports up to 8,000 lbs.

item.name: Driftglobe
item.description: A small, heavy glass sphere that hums faintly with arcane energy.
item.uses: Command word causes it to float and shed Light (or Daylight once per day) while following you.

item.name: Spell Scroll (Invisibility)
item.description: A ribbon-tied parchment sheet bearing glowing silver ink runes.
item.uses: Action to read and cast the Invisibility spell. The scroll crumbles to dust upon completion.

item.name: Amulet of Health
item.description: A thick platinum medallion set with a large, polished bloodstone.
item.uses: Your Constitution score becomes 19 while wearing this amulet. Has no effect if Constitution is already 19 or higher.

item.name: Dust of Disappearance
item.description: A small pouch filled with glittering, translucent sand that slips through your fingers.
item.uses: Action to throw into the air; renders creatures and objects within a 10-foot radius invisible for 2d4 minutes.

item.name: Shield +1
item.description: A heavy steel shield polished to a mirror shine, adorned with a crest of a griffon.
item.uses: Grants an additional +1 bonus to AC over a standard shield (total +3 AC).

item.name: Alchemy Jug
item.description: A heavy ceramic vessel that sloshes continuously even when empty.
item.uses: Action to name a liquid (e.g., water, wine, honey, acid, mayonnaise) to produce up to its daily limit.

item.name: Bag of Tricks (Gray)
item.description: A small, fuzzy cloth sack that feels oddly heavy and rumbles when shaken.
item.uses: Action to pull a fuzzy ball and throw it up to 20 feet to summon a friendly random beast (e.g., giant rat, badger, dire wolf).

item.name: Sentinel Shield
item.description: A round wooden shield painted with an open, vigilant eye that never blinks.
item.uses: Grants advantage on initiative checks and Wisdom (Perception) checks while held.

item.name: Decanter of Endless Water
item.description: An flask-shaped stoppered urn made of carved blue stone and silver trim.
item.uses: Command word unstoppers the vessel to produce stream, fountain, or geyser amounts of fresh or salt water.

item.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
item.description: A silver chain holding a polished red jasper pendant shaped like a beating heart.
item.uses: Stabilizes you automatically when dying, and doubles the hit points regained whenever you spend a Hit Die.

item.name: Goggles of Night
item.description: Dark leather goggles set with polished dark glass lenses encased in brass rims.
item.uses: Grants darkvision out to a range of 60 feet (or increases existing darkvision range by 60 feet).

item.name: Cloak of Protection
item.description: A heavy, dark blue mantle reinforced with subtle metallic threading along the seams.
item.uses: Grants a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn.

item.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
item.description: A plain silver ring mounted with a clear quartz gem that flickers with faint light.
item.uses: Immunizes you to telepathy and thought-reading; allows your soul to inhabit the ring if you die while wearing it.

item.name: Eversmoking Bottle
item.description: A heavy brass lead-plugged urn that feels warm to the touch and hums softly.
item.uses: Unplugging the bottle releases thick smoke, creating a 60-foot radius heavily obscured area in minutes.

item.name: Dagger +1
item.description: A razor-sharp obsidian dagger with a pommel carved in the shape of a serpent head.
item.uses: Grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

item.name: Keoghtom's Ointment
item.description: A small wooden jar containing a thick, sweet-smelling ointment that glimmers faintly.
item.uses: Contains 1d4+2 doses. Applying a dose cures 2d8+2 hit points, neutralizes poison, and cures disease.

item.name: Winged Boots
item.description: Supple leather boots adorned with small, feather-like silver wings along the ankles.
item.uses: Grants a flying speed equal to your walking speed for up to 4 hours per day.

item.name: Saddle of the Cavalier
item.description: A dark leather military saddle etched with protective runes along the stirrups.
item.uses: Prevents you from being dismounted against your will, and attack rolls against your mount have disadvantage.

item.name: Lantern of Revealing
item.description: A heavy brass hood-lantern fitted with stained green glass panes.
item.uses: Sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius that reveals invisible creatures and objects.

item.name: Gem of Seeing
item.description: A finely cut, polished diamond that glimmers with an inner, pale blue spark.
item.uses: Action to look through the gem to gain truesight out to 120 feet for 10 minutes (3 charges daily).

item.name: Bracers of Archery
item.description: Reinforced leather armguards stamped with the crest of a silver stag.
item.uses: Grants proficiency with longbows/shortbows and a +2 bonus to damage rolls with them.

item.name: Brooch of Shielding
item.description: A heavy gold clasp shaped like a miniature kite shield.
item.uses: Grants resistance to force damage and total immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell.

item.name: Staff of the Adder
item.description: A gnarled wooden quarterstaff carved to resemble a coiled viper at the tip.
item.uses: Bonus action turns the head into a venomous snake that bites for 1d6 piercing + 3d6 poison damage.

item.name: Elixir of Health
item.description: A thick, milky-white potion that smells faintly of peppermint and fresh rain.
item.uses: Drinking cures all diseases, neutralizes all poisons, and removes the blinded, deafened, and paralyzed conditions.

item.name: Chime of Opening
item.description: A hollow metal tube etched with delicate keyhole patterns along its length.
item.uses: Action to strike the chime; emits a clear tone that automatically unlocks a nonmagical lock or suppression ward.

item.name: Mantle of Spell Resistance
item.description: A flowing velvet cloak embroidered with glowing silver wards along the hem.
item.uses: Grants advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects while worn.

item.name: Quaal's Feather Token (Tree)
item.description: A small, dried bird feather dyed deep forest green.
item.uses: Action to touch to the ground, instantly sprouting an 60-foot tall oak tree that bursts nonmagical stone.

item.name: Robe of Useful Items
item.description: A plain cloth robe covered in dozens of odd, brightly colored cloth patches.
item.uses: Detaching a patch transforms it into a real item (e.g., daggers, lanterns, 24-foot wooden ladder, rowboat).

item.name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
item.description: Light cloth shoes with soles that feel strangely tacky to the touch.
item.uses: Allows you to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, leaving hands free.

item.name: Stone of Good Luck
item.description: An unpolished piece of green agate that feels smooth and warm in your palm.
item.uses: Grants a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws while carried.

item.name: Wand of Web
item.description: A slender wand made of petrified wood wrapped tightly in thick spider silk.
item.uses: Action to expend 1 charge to cast the Web spell (7 charges daily, regains 1d6+1 at dawn).

item.name: Horn of Blasting
item.description: A curved war horn crafted from the polished horn of a red dragon, bound in brass.
item.uses: Action to blow, emitting a thunderous blast dealing 5d6 thunder damage in a 30-foot cone (20% chance to shatter).

item.name: Pipes of Haunting
item.description: Pan pipes carved from bleached bone that produce an eerie, echoing whisper when held.
item.uses: Playing the pipes forces creatures within 30 feet to make a Wisdom save or become frightened for 1 minute.

item.name: Ring of Water Walking
item.description: A band of coral setting a clear aquamarine gemstone.
item.uses: Allows you to walk on liquid surfaces (water, mud, oil, snow, lava) as if they were solid ground.

item.name: Boots of Levitation
item.description: High leather riding boots lined with soft blue velvet and silver stitching.
item.uses: Action to activate, casting the Levitate spell on yourself at will.

item.name: Bag of Devouring
item.description: An innocuous cloth sack that resembles a Bag of Holding, but feels faintly warm and wet inside.
item.uses: Consumes any organic material placed inside; creatures pulled inside take continuous acid damage and risk being digested.
